cards.subject: A city of three clans
lines: Bronzebeard, Wildhammer and Dark Iron all lived in these halls under one high king.
You are standing in the winner's version of it.

cards.subject: The War of the Three Hammers
cards.tag: It started over an empty throne
lines: When the high king died the Dark Iron tried to take the city. All three clans went to war in these corridors.
The Bronzebeards won and threw the other two out.
Ironforge was damaged badly enough that it had to be rebuilt afterwards.

cards.subject: Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan
lines: Losing the war, he cast a spell to pull fire to himself, and summoned the Firelord by mistake.
It killed him instantly and blew the land into what is now Blackrock Mountain and the Burning Steppes.
His clan survived and were enslaved by the thing he called.

cards.subject: The Great Forge
lines: The dwarves built it as an altar to the titan who made them, and the city grew around it afterwards.
Ironforge is named for the forge, not the other way round.
Everything else radiates out from it in rings, going deeper as it goes out.

cards.subject: Old Ironforge
lines: There is a chamber below the High Seat that was built into the game and then simply closed.
The doors do not open. They stay shut for six years.
The only people who ever saw inside got there by exploit.

cards.subject: Tinker Town
cards.tag: A refugee camp with a train station
lines: The gnomes are here because Gnomeregan is gone. They irradiated their own city and Magni gave them room in his.
The tram station is in their quarter because they are the ones who dug it.
It is the only district in any capital that belongs to a homeless people.

cards.subject: The window halfway
lines: The middle stretch runs under a lake behind glass, and there is something large out there in the dark.
Sharks, naga, a giant clam, a shipwreck, and a diver.
Nearly everybody sits down and looks at the floor for the whole ride.

seed.body: Stand at the glass on the tram instead of sitting. There is a whole scene out there in the water.

cards.subject: Moira Bronzebeard
lines: She was taken by the Dark Iron emperor and is held in Blackrock Depths.
When adventurers kill him she refuses to come home. She is carrying his child.
Magni rules here without an heir who will speak to him.

cards.subject: The Hall of Explorers
lines: The exhibits are not scenery. They are named objects with plaques, and a curator who looks after them.
Fossilised eggs, a pterodon skeleton, an astrolabe, a horn that belonged to a specific animal with a name.
There is also a back room of things not on display.

seed.body: Read the plaques in the Hall of Explorers. They are all written, and almost nobody has ever read one.

cards.subject: The Skull of Tyrannistrasz
cards.tag: The dragon skull, and its plaque
lines: It is not a generic dragon. The plaque names him and says he was rumoured to be the elder consort of the Dragonqueen.
He was dug out of the Wetlands after the battle at Grim Batol.
His name is misspelled on the exhibit and stays misspelled for years.

cards.subject: The Uldaman finds
lines: The Explorers' League digs for dwarven heritage rather than ore, and this is the room the answers come back to.
Two of the cases hold what they brought out of Uldaman.
What Uldaman says about where dwarves came from is not the story the dwarves grew up with.
